messages:
maya: Heads-up - the new 4-bit PTQ reranker (v4-4bit) shows a ~1.8% NDCG@10 regression vs fp16 on our cross-domain benchmark. Not massive but consistent across runs.
dan: across all datasets or concentrated?
maya: concentrated on doc-heavy slices (avg doc tokens > 1.2k) and queries where the relevant passage is near the truncation boundary.
hao: could be tokenization/truncation interplay or KV-cache alignment post-quant. Any diffs in preprocess between eval harness and prod serving?
maya: yep. Eval harness chunks docs into fixed 256-token passages and keeps top-3 per doc, while prod concatenates anchor + doc and truncates to 512 total. That changes which passage gets scored.
sara: that's a pretty big behavioral mismatch. We should either make eval simulate concat-truncate or make prod use passage-chunking.
man: (on phone) is the regression worse for 4-bit than 8-bit?
maya: 8-bit PTQ earlier was ~0.2% from fp16; 4-bit shows more sensitivity. My hypothesis: lower precision increases sensitivity to token boundary context that moves when chunking vs concat-trunc.
dan: we need quick repro that isolates chunking vs quant. Can you run 3 evals: fp16 concat-trunc, 4bit concat-trunc, 4bit chunked (eval baseline) and produce per-query top1 swap list?
maya: running now. Command I used: 
```
# concat-trunc
python eval_harness.py --strategy=concat_trunc --max_total=512 --model=rerank-v4-fp16
# chunked
python eval_harness.py --strategy=chunked_passages --passage_len=256 --topk_per_doc=3 --model=rerank-v4-4bit
```
ops-bot: job started: rerank-qa-2134567890 (run=9901).
hao: also capture the "golden offset" (pct through original doc) and slice by that. If gold is near the edge we expect flips.
maya: will dump flips.csv with columns: query_id, gold_pos_pct, baseline_rank, ptq_rank, swap_reason_hint. ETA 20m.
sara: once we have flips, can we compute the fraction of flips attributable purely to chunking (i.e., run 4bit with chunking but with fp16 weights)? That'll show quant-specific amplifying effect.
man: +1. And consider a quick patch: in eval harness add a small jitter augmentation that randomly shifts truncation window +/- 64 tokens to make eval robust.
dan: agree on augmentation as long-term. Short-term: change the automated gate so any new onboarded model must pass concat-trunc eval for a sample of prod traffic.
maya: noted. I'll upload artifacts and open a PR to update the onboarding checklist with the concat test. tagging @hao @sara.
ops-bot: job completed: rerank-qa-2134567890 (run=9901) status=success.
hao: thanks. post the CSV link and I'll run a quick causal analysis to estimate how much regression is chunking vs quant noise.
maya: link: s3://rerank-artifacts/2134567890/flips.csv. Starting analysis now.
